decisionScopeNote: Applies retroactively to every existing link and to all future ingestion.
question: Does a second source by the SAME educator constitute independent confirmation of a claim, and may it therefore raise that claim's confidence?
optionsConsidered: Treat every registered source as an independent group, so two videos by one educator can carry a claim from 'emerging' to 'supported'
Collapse all sources by the same educator into a single independence group, so repetition by one person never raises confidence on its own
Apply a partial discount to same-educator sources rather than collapsing them entirely
selectedOption: Collapse all sources by the same educator into a single independence group, so repetition by one person never raises confidence on its own
rationale: Owner directive of 2026-07-27: 'Do not treat repetition by the same educator as independent confirmation.' The confidence engine keys independence groups on sourceId by default, so before this decision a second Alex G video would have created a second group and could have carried shared claims from 'emerging' (22 points) to 'supported' (45) purely because one person said the same thing twice. That is consistency, not corroboration. POLICY-001 section G1 identified this exact lever and recommended deciding it BEFORE a second same-educator intake; this decision does so, one ingestion ahead of the case that would have triggered it. IMPLEMENTATION: EvidenceClaimLink.independenceGroup is set to 'AUTHOR|{traderId}' for every link, overriding the sourceId default already honoured by evidence_confidence._independence_groups(). No engine change was required. Applied retroactively to all 123 existing links across 104 claims; every affected claim's confidence was recomputed, and none changed state (all remain 'emerging'), confirming the policy tightens a ceiling rather than lowering existing scores. CONSEQUENCE THE OWNER SHOULD SEE: combined with the existing property that trader-scoped claims never merge (compute_claim_fingerprint includes traderId, so agreement BETWEEN educators also does not raise confidence), replay validation is now the ONLY remaining route by which any claim can reach 'supported'. That is a coherent and defensible position -- a trader restating himself, and a second trader agreeing, are both weaker than a test -- but it should be an explicit choice rather than an emergent one. If the owner wants cross-educator agreement to count, the recommended mechanism is a separate Concept-level consensus count (see CROSS-STRATEGY-ANALYSIS.md section 8 D2), not a relaxation of this decision.
